description: Work out the Speed of several Pokémon in Pokémon Champions and the order they move in, including the effect of items such as Choice Scarf, Tailwind, paralysis, stat stages, weather abilities and Trick Room. Use it to answer who outspeeds whom. Any part of a set that is left out is filled in from the regulation's usage statistics and listed under `assumptions`. Speed decides order only among moves of the same priority.

format.description: Regulation id from list_formats. Defaults to "champions-regmc" (Pokémon Champions — Regulation M-C).

pokemon.description: The Pokémon to compare. The same Pokémon may appear with two sets.

ability.description: Ability. Defaults to the Pokémon's most used ability in the regulation.

abilityActive.description: A conditional Speed ability is active, such as Unburden after its item is used. Weather abilities follow `weather` and need no flag.

boosts.description: Stat stages from moves and abilities, -6 to +6. For example { atk: 2 }.

item.description: Held item, or "none". Defaults to the Pokémon's most used item in the regulation.

nature.description: Nature, such as Adamant or Timid. If nature and statPoints are both left out, the Pokémon's most common spread in the regulation's usage statistics is used.

pokemon.description: Pokémon name in English. Mega Evolutions are tracked separately, e.g. "Charizard-Mega-Y"

statPoints.description: Pokémon Champions stat points per stat (0–32 each, 66 in total). Stats left out get 0.

status.description: Burn halves physical damage dealt; paralysis halves Speed.

trickRoom.description: Trick Room is up: slower moves first

name: compare_speed

assumptions.description: Everything the calculation assumed, including any part of a set that was filled in because it was not given. Tell the user about these.

format.description: Regulation id the result applies to

title: Compare Speed and turn order
